provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
story: From Nombre de Dios it runs 261 km to Nombre de Dios; allow about 4 h 30 of riding. The stops in between: Former hacienda of San Diego de Navacoyán, Temple of the town of San José de Avino and back through Former hacienda of San Diego de Navacoyán. The highest point is about 2,150 m. The line favours views over speed.
